name: Mirion Technologies, Inc.
summary: Mirion Technologies, Inc. provides radiation detection, measurement, analysis, and monitoring products and services in North America, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It operates in two segments, Medical, and Nuclear & Safety. The Medical segment offers radiation oncology quality assurance and dosimetry solutions; patient safety solutions for diagnostic imaging and radiation therapy centers; radiation therapy quality assurance solutions for calibrating and verifying imaging and treatment accuracy; and radionuclide therapy products for nuclear medicine applications, such as product handling, medical imaging furniture, and rehabilitation products.
